maddeler.e:
تنتبهين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَبِهِينَ (tantabihīna) /tan.ta.bi.hiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# تُنْتَبَهِينَ (tuntabahīna) /tun.ta.ba.hiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
